## Frequently asked questions

### Where is RSB Wedding Caterers?

### What facilities does RSB Wedding Caterers have?
Tamil Iyer weddings, Telugu Iyer weddings, Tamil Iyengar weddings, Upanayanam, Nichayadartham, Seemantham, Sashtiapthapoorthi & Sadhabhisekam, Event décor, Marriage planning, Banana-leaf meals.

### Do you plan the whole wedding?
Yes. RSB's marriage planning takes you from concept to completion, including décor and cuisine.
